{{See also|List of Single-board computers}}
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: ''[[Rockchip]]'' RK3506G2 :Tri-core ([[ARM]] Cortex-A7) @1.2GHz + :([[ARM]] Cortex-M0) @200MHz *Memory: 128MB embedded DDR3L *Storage: 256MB (SLC) NAND Flash, :TF card (max.64GB)/MMC card *Network: 1x Fast Ethernet *USB: 1x USB Type-C (OTG), :1x 4-pin USB 2.0 (OTG) connector *GPIO: 2x 20-pin Headers *Power Source: 5V/1A via USB Type-C
